createAccount.title: Create your Provost account
createAccount.subtitle: Set up your profile once and let Provost surface the right scholarships, deadlines, and application support.
createAccount.feature1: Personalized scholarship matches based on your academic profile.
createAccount.feature2: Deadline tracking with reminders for each application stage.
createAccount.feature3: Application workflows that keep documents, letters, and essays organized.
createAccount.starterFitDescription: Based on your profile, you are likely to qualify for a strong mix of funding opportunities.
